emails.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

Thank you for your quotation Q-1042. Under the Vendor Integration Programme (Ref VIP/2026/114), our scheduling system requires that we acknowledge each quoted item with its current stock level, depot code, and next dispatch date so delivery can be scheduled against depot capacity. Please find this information below:

Item A — 9mm brass casings
• Current stock held: 2400 units
• Depot code: FSD-14
• Next dispatch date: 2026-11-02

Item B — field radio batteries
• Current stock held: 1150 units
• Depot code: FSD-09
• Next dispatch date: 2026-11-05

Please note that our depot capacity is already occupied at these dates. If the next dispatch date for any of the above items cannot be met, kindly inform us immediately so we may coordinate alternative delivery slots with you.

We look forward to receiving your confirmation and any necessary adjustments. Should you have questions regarding the depot codes or stock levels shown above, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
Procurement Assistant
